material.description: Symptom: the client renders the modal from generic widget kinds (js/client/widgets.js, modui.js); it has no kinds for a portrait grid, an attribute-labelled row group, a stat bar, or a full-screen three-region layout, so the Lua redesign cannot be drawn. Add general widget kinds, named by what they show, never by genre (memory: engine adaptability, no genre presets or checks). Ownership: js/client/widgets.js, js/client/modui.js, js/client/play.html and its CSS. Do not edit hud.js or play.js (another lane). Acceptance: a tree with a region container, a portrait grid, a labelled row group and a stat bar renders in the modal; existing modal kinds render unchanged; CI static client checks pass. Witness: CI green on the pushed sha; the visual check waits on the browser verb.
material.subject: Game-start lobby: client widgets for the all-pick layout (portrait grid, attribute rows, stat bars, regions)
material.witness: ci-status sha 7ab8ff07bd64669205979787cdb7c4bcf083ac49 (run 40169690344): run_status success, job_counts success 6/6 (ci 3/3 incl. static client checks, pages 3/3), pending 0, failure 0. Commit adds regions, portraits, rows, statbar to js/client/widgets.js; parse-checked locally with node --input-type=module --check (read-only).
